questions.stem: What is the value of i^4?
questions.solution: The powers of i follow a repeating pattern: i, -1, -i, 1. Since 4 is an even number, i^4 will be 1.
questions.explanation: The value of i raised to an even power is always 1 because the imaginary unit cancels itself out.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be selecting A (-1) or C (i), which are correct for odd powers of i.
